attempts.text:
The minimum total cost is 250: 130 minutes of driving plus 120 in deferral penalties. I worked this out by hand by comparing the route options, and didn't run it through a solver.

**Key constraints**
- **Evacuation point:** Kakani shelter is the only valid drop-off. Tarkeshwar school isn't designated.
- **Belkot farm:** Its only road is closed, so the 2 adults there can't be reached and must be deferred (penalty 40).
- **Myagang market:** This is reachable only through Naukunda school, because the Benighat road is out. A round trip from Kakani takes 108 minutes, while deferring all 4 adults costs 80, so deferring is cheaper. Carrying only some of them with the Naukunda children also costs more overall.

**Rescue trips (all return to Kakani)**

| Trip | Car | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | car1 | Kakani → Tarkeshwar → Kakani | 4 injured | 24 |
| 2 | car2 | Kakani → Tarkeshwar → Benighat → Tarkeshwar → Kakani | 4 adults | 52 |
| 3 | car1 | Kakani → Tarkeshwar → Naukunda → Kakani | 4 children (1 from Tarkeshwar, 3 from Naukunda) | 54 |

**Cost**
- **Driving:** 24 + 52 + 54 = 130
- **Deferrals:** 6 adults × 20 = 120 (4 at Myagang market, 2 at Belkot farm)
- **Total:** 130 + 120 = 250

All injured people and children are rescued, and only adults are deferred. The 6 deferred adults will still need help in the later wave, including the 2 at Belkot farm, who will need another way in unless the road reopens.

<plan>
drive car1 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car2 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
drive car2 tarkeshwar-school benighat-farm
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 benighat-farm tarkeshwar-school
drive car2 tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter
unload car2 adult 4
drive car1 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
load car1 child 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-school naukunda-school
load car1 child 3
drive car1 naukunda-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 child 4
defer myagang-market adult 4
defer belkot-farm adult 2
</plan>

COST: 250
